📦 **Blocksail `1f6e27cf`** — art: restyle ten officers to Astrid and place transparent figures in tavern

Redraw five first mates and five surgeons using the supplied Astrid style.
Generate genuine transparent RGBA masters with built-in image_gen; preserve
original calli character cards and artwork, record redraw credit and prompts.
Correct Violette's hair back to her canonical shoulder-length purple style.

Replace the ten runtime images without changing character IDs or stats.
Recruitment separates readable copy from a full-body character standing on the
tavern floor; mobile stacks figure above copy. Transparent slot backgrounds.

Validation: all ten PNG alpha ranges include 0 and 255; all ten load on actual
UI switches; 390px dialog/scroll width both357px. Screenshots and generation
provenance in docs/evidence/crew-restyle. Existing recruit_check passes.
This batch covers the requested ten; the other twelve retain their old images.

Refs TASK-1185

👥 參與者：@meadow
